verdict.rationale: Mercury states it natively syncs with QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite, with AI-powered automations to speed up closing the books (mercury-docs-6). Receipts are auto-attached to card transactions (mercury-docs-5, mercury-docs-28), and OAuth access is explicitly aimed at accounting tools that integrate with Mercury (mercury-docs-56). Missing for 10: detailed docs on what syncs (transactions, expenses, receipts, categories) and how often, account and category mapping behavior, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the sync works.
